summary: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64 ships a Go binary that opens a PTY-over-WebSocket backdoor and harvests Anthropic API keys
details: The package ships a darwin/arm64 Go executable that links github.com/creack/pty (PTY spawning) and github.com/coder/websocket, and hardcodes the WebSocket endpoint wss://relay.sextant.top plus https://relay.sextant.top/install. On invocation the binary connects to that relay and can pipe an interactive PTY over the WebSocket, giving the remote server shell-level control of the installer's host. The same binary embeds a regex matching Anthropic secret keys (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}), references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models (a live key-validation endpoint), and performs a host geolocation lookup via http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query. Additional strings reference https://claude.ai/install.sh together with curl/sudo/brew/bun tokens, providing a path for remote-directed fetch-and-execute of shell installers. package.json declares its license as "SEE LICENSE IN https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control", tying the artifact to a project literally named claude_control.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
